# cubepath_alert_channel (Resource)

Manages a Cloud Alerts notification channel: a Slack or Discord webhook, or the email of the account that creates it. Alert rules send their notifications to channels. The API never returns a webhook URL after it is set, so changes made outside Terraform to it are not detected. Import with the channel ID (webhook_url imports empty).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name, unique in the organization: up to 64 letters, numbers, spaces and hyphens.
- `type` (String) Channel type: slack, discord or email. Changing it forces a new channel.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the channel is enabled. Defaults to true.
- `webhook_url` (String, Sensitive) Incoming webhook URL, required for slack (https://hooks.slack.com/services/...) and discord (https://discord.com/api/webhooks/...). Must not be set for email.

### Read-Only

- `email` (String) For email channels, the address notifications go to (the creator's account email).
- `id` (String) The ID of the channel.
